summary.text: Rex F. Rice is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 2, which covers Greenville and Pickens Counties.
His official page lists him as a businessman who served in the S.C. House from 1995 to 2010.

paragraphs.text: Rice was born on May 9, 1957, in Pensacola, Florida, and attended Anderson College and the University of South Carolina.
He served in the S.C. House of Representatives from 1995 to 2010.
His Senate committees are Corrections and Penology, Education, Finance, Labor, Commerce and Industry, and Transportation.
